en: Sepia-toned street scene showing a European city with cobblestone pavement, early 20th‑century pedestrians in long coats, horse-drawn vehicles, and a tram track. The view is dominated by a tall church with a distinctive, slender spire rising above the surrounding historic buildings; other smaller spires are visible behind it. On the right are multi‑story stone and masonry buildings with rounded corners and large windows, typical of early 1900s urban architecture. Trees line the left side of the street. In red ink near the top edge is a handwritten marking that appears to read '1/10'.
